messages.subject: reactivty and tabs
parts:
Hi,

I have a shiny app with sideBarLayout and mainpanel has 3 tabs, call them summary, outTable, outPlot.  The sidebar inputs are use to construct queries to a database.  Panel summary shows simple summary information about the people returned by a query.

Panels outTable and outPlot share a possibly large data frame that takes a couple of minutes to query and return from sqlQuery (could be 500K+ rows).  I tried to cache the data.frame with a reactive object

    getOutputDF <- reactive({ .. sqlQuery ..})
   
    output$outTable <- renderTable({ out.df <- getOutputDF() ... })
    output$outPlot  <- renderPlot   ({ out.df <- getOutputDF() ... })

However, it seems that changing the tabPanel forces a new call of getOuputDF.

How can I isolate getOutputDF() so it only updates when the sidebarPanel UI items are updated and not depend on the tab selection?

thanks.
